### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-03T12:39:55Z: [https://home.kz](https://home.kz); asset [https://home.kz/strapi/uploads/Logotip\_banka\_36d8b1bd8d.svg](https://home.kz/strapi/uploads/Logotip_banka_36d8b1bd8d.svg). homecredit.kz now serves https://home.kz; header logo raster \(research-only\) and the official SVG logo use the red arch figure + HOME CREDIT BANK wordmark in #DB0124. (independence group: homekz-site).
- official checked 2026-10-03T12:39:55Z: [https://home.kz](https://home.kz). Site favicon/apple-icon PNGs \(research-only, 96/180px\) show the red arch figure standalone on transparent, matching the proposed standalone presentation. (independence group: homekz-site).

- Currency: confirmed — Live site fetched 2026-10-03; the red #DB0124 figure and wordmark are the current branding, continuing after the 2025 ownership change..
- Variant: confirmed — Current variant is the standalone red figure on transparent; the base icon is the older presentation \(crimson disc, white figure\). Same underlying symbol, presentation/color update..
- Uncertainty: Standalone-figure presentation is confirmed by raster favicon/app icons \(research-only\); the vector for the standalone figure is the 'O' sub-shape of the official combined-logo vector, presented via a viewport crop that changes no path geometry..

Rationale: The bank's own live site \(home.kz, reached from homecredit.kz\) publishes this vector logo and uses the arch figure standalone in its favicon/app icons; the base icon is the older presentation of the same symbol \(crimson #C8102E disc with inverted white figure\). Visible difference: Deliberate presentation update: the enclosed-disc badge is replaced by the bank's current standalone open figure in the current red. Source-versus-final shows no unintended difference — the final is literally the same vector sub-shape..
Details: Ring, inner opening and the head/smile shape render crisply at 240px on both themes; uniform #DB0124; no clipped strokes after the crop \(bounds verified against the source raster\).. Proportions: The figure's own aspect \(~126x92\) is preserved by the crop viewBox; in the square catalog cell it letterboxes centered without stretching, matching the standalone favicon presentation..

Source-to-final transformations:
- Working SVG derived from the original downloaded vector by viewport crop only: the original single path is byte-unchanged; viewBox set to the figure's bounding region \(110.86 11.61 126.28 92.05\) so only the 'O' figure of HOME shows, matching the bank's standalone-figure usage; the paint attribute serialization was normalized to fill="#DB0124" with the identical color taken from the original .st0 CSS class.
- SVGO 4.1.0 with the frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs \(sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e\): working 2463 bytes -\> trial 2214 bytes; selected the optimized trial as final \(sha256 0e534158b23de8a650ee534c804737532c44f07f0de327b72e36155f5c2d736b\) after working-versus-optimized comparison with rsvg at 240px on white and #121212: visually identical; no path geometry or color change.
